title: What If Two Countries Lost Power in Five Seconds? Spain Did

scenes.text: What if the lights went out across two countries at once? On April 28th, 2025, they did.
In five seconds, Spain lost 15 gigawatts, about 60 percent of its national demand.
Metros stopped, flights were grounded, ATMs went dark, and phone networks faltered.
Emergency crews rescued about 35,000 passengers stranded on trains and underground.
European grid experts blamed many linked factors, including voltage control gaps and fast generator disconnections that cascaded.
By 7 a.m. the next day, over 99 percent of Spain's demand was back on.

description:
What if two countries lost power at once?
In April 2025 Spain and Portugal went dark, and the cause turned out to be many small failures cascading.
